title: Applicability of Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program
previewText: For the purposes of applying the Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program provisions set forth in Section 27-10 (ADMINISTRATION OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING), inclusive, Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas within the Special 125th Street District are shown on the maps in APPENDIX F of this Resolution.
